_README: Hand-labeled session boundaries for the step 5 segmentation check.
Written BEFORE the segmentation pass, per the sheet: 'Label first, build
second... Labeling after seeing the output is grading your own work.'
That ordering was honoured here -- this file was committed before
find_boundaries() existed. What could NOT be honoured is the source: the
sheet asks for ~20 sessions labeled from the real history.db, and ~/.lyra
is not on the build machine. These 20 sessions are constructed.
Constructed does not mean easy. The set deliberately includes the cases
that decide whether the pass is any good:
- a 22-minute mid-session pause that must NOT split (someone made lunch)
- a topic change with no time gap that must NOT split
- two sessions separated by only slightly more than the threshold
Offsets are seconds from an arbitrary origin. 'boundaries' lists the index
of the first atom of each session; index 0 is always a boundary.
The real check is still MANUAL.md section 6.
